raw_baseline.scope: Verified pre-change immutable baseline referenced directly; no redundant whole-snapshot copy

reference.scope: V8+shared certificate and public API resolution fixes; original unsafe V8 is not a runtime comparator

protocol.reference_description: Frozen phase008 V8 plus identical candidate certificate (including public dtype aliases) and public API resolution fixes; raw V8 remains static certificate counterfactual only
protocol.reference_label_zh: V8＋共同證書及公開 API 解析修正
protocol.primary: Common frozen v2 observer on originally valid sources. Report total joint units plus certificate-and-required-backward-and-operand-gradient qualified joint units, training and memory×training goal attainment, context contracts separately. No invalid source rescue or inferred backward storage. MR applicability and valid yield per actual search second are co-primary feasibility diagnostics; do not optimize only easy MRs.
protocol.heldout_policy: Six APIs are search-campaign-heldout, may exist in unit fixtures/code. Lock before execution; no adaptive replacement/tuning after their results. Unsupported paths remain explicit unknown/invalid.
protocol.corpora: Fresh isolated arm/API outputs; no corpus or seed sharing
protocol.pairing: Deterministic arm-order alternation by panel/API index; fresh isolated corpus for every arm/API. Same vLLM service/provider/model/temperature/seed and testing GPU; model/kernel cache warmness is not eliminated.
protocol.timing: Search budgets include exception reruns and automatic replay. Original detection timestamp remains pre-replay. Metadata setup, fixture/regression/control validation, posthoc evaluator replay and common scoring are separate costs.
protocol.interpretation: Single-seed descriptive comparison; no individual-component causality or statistical significance.
protocol.audit_provenance: Existing evaluator may reuse original numerical oracle. Raw confirmed_* are evaluator adjudications, not independent defect confirmation. Transfer targets have no known fixture labels.

reference.scope: Supplied known triggers and controls, not autonomous discoveries

candidate.scope: Supplied known triggers and controls, not autonomous discoveries

protocol.structural_controls_scope: Previously frozen generic controls; not new held-out transfer evidence

evaluator_provenance.scope: Raw existing-evaluator adjudication/reproduction; may reuse original oracle. Not independent defect confirmation.

reference.scope: Existing evaluator adjudication and original-engine replay; some evaluator paths reuse the original GenericFD oracle. Raw confirmed_* fields are not independent defect confirmation. Only ten seen fixtures have known mechanism labels; transfer targets have no such labels.

candidate.scope: Existing evaluator adjudication and original-engine replay; some evaluator paths reuse the original GenericFD oracle. Raw confirmed_* fields are not independent defect confirmation. Only ten seen fixtures have known mechanism labels; transfer targets have no such labels.

measurement_definitions.planned_attempts: 維持既有數值定義：row 有非空 state_plan 或 configuration.predicates。含其修復及執行失敗；不含尚未形成計畫的規劃拒絕。這是 training_goal_retention 的分母。
measurement_definitions.scheduler_planned_attempts: candidate.kind='planned' 的 rows，含 cached plan、planning rejection 與 repair；不是獨立 sampler 決策數，與 planned_attempts 分開。
measurement_definitions.planning_stage_rejections: first_blocking_stage='state_plan' 的 rows；不推論沒有合法路徑，也不把未標此stage的 provider failure 納入。
measurement_definitions.qualified_source_joint: 原始來源有效且 mutation obligations 未失敗、原始 program certificate 存在、config 明確要求 backward 且原始 inspector 驗證其路徑，再要求同一 joint 的至少一端（不是兩端）relations 含 operand_gradient_contribution。不同 API 的 joint 單位相加；這不是 memory×training 顯式目標合取成功，也不是梯度數值正確性證明。
measurement_definitions.memory_training_goal_attained_valid: 配置同時含 representation/tensor_relation 與 training-state predicates，原始來源有效且 target_state_reached=True；與觀測到的 qualified joint 分開。
measurement_definitions.context_target_forward_only_valid: 配置為 autocast/no_grad/enable_grad，明確 requires_backward=False，且原始來源有效；這是合法 context target 路徑，無須補造 backward。
measurement_definitions.context_contract_valid_sources: 原始 record.context_contract=True 且來源有效；此旗標表明 context observer 支援目標，不單獨證明 enter/exit 生命週期已執行。
measurement_definitions.native_units: 保留原生版本與回饋，主要比較採共同 final v2 scorer，不能把原生版本不同當成探索增益。

limitations: 每組只有 seed 0；這是描述性配對比較，無統計顯著性或單一元件因果結論。
參考組是 V8 加該次協定列明的共同修正；具體 overlay 與 hash 隨報表保存。未修正 V8 僅供靜態接受範圍審查，不能當作可信執行基準。
正式每 API 120 秒；歷史 phase008 為 180 秒，歷史總數不是相同預算的比較。
transfer 僅指先前搜尋活動未使用；API 可能已出現在既有程式或單元測試。不可稱為未見過實作。
共同 v2 覆蓋只採原始有效來源；來源與 followup 分開。MR 不適用不抹除有效來源，但也不算正確性通過。
合格 joint 子集要求原始證書、所需 backward 已驗證，且至少一端有 operand-gradient evidence；不代表兩端皆可微、梯度數值正確或 backward 所儲存表示已觀測。
單運算元及 context API 未必能形成兩 tensor joint；須同時讀 unary、訓練目標與 context 證據，不以 joint 零值直接判定無效。
shared storage 不代表占用座標重疊；未知梯度路徑仍是未知。candidate 上限遺漏不是已證明不可達。
同服務、模型及 GPU 可減少環境差異，交替順序仍無法消除模型與 kernel cache、服務時間漂移。
原 evaluator 的 confirmed_* 部分重用原 GenericFD oracle；重現／機制比對不是全部獨立確認，本報表不宣稱已確認框架缺陷。
搜尋時間含例外重跑與 automatic replay；metadata、驗證、posthoc evaluator replay、共同計分另列，不重複加總重疊成本。
